Conducted competitive analysis of 8 leading financial services portals
challengesEncountered: Need alignment on mobile-first vs responsive design approach

executiveSummary.overview: Modernize the existing client portal to deliver a best-in-class digital experience that reduces support calls, increases client engagement, and positions FIS as a technology leader in the wealth management space.
strategicAlignment: Supports Client Satisfaction KPI improvement goals
Enables competitive differentiation in RFP processes
benefits: **Improved Client Satisfaction**: Modern, intuitive interface expected to increase NPS by 15-20 points
**Operational Efficiency**: Reduce support call volume by 30% through self-service capabilities
**Revenue Protection**: Prevent client churn estimated at $2.3M annually
outcomes: Launch updated portal to 5 pilot clients by June 2025
Achieve 80% client adoption within 6 months of full rollout
Establish portal as platform for future digital services

problemStatement.issue: Current client portal is outdated (built in 2016), lacks mobile optimization, and generates 200+ support calls per month due to usability issues. Client feedback consistently cites the portal as a pain point in relationship reviews.
problemStatement.businessImpact: Portal deficiencies contributed to loss of 2 major clients ($800K AUM) in 2024. Annual support costs attributed to portal issues exceed $150K. RFP win rate decreased 12% when portal demos are included.
problemStatement.marketContext: Competitors have launched modern, mobile-first portals with enhanced features. Recent market research shows 78% of clients expect banking-grade digital experiences from all financial service providers.
problemStatement.operationalContext: Current portal runs on legacy technology stack with limited internal expertise. IT team spends 40% of maintenance time on portal-related issues. No API layer exists for future integrations.

specific: Redesign and rebuild client portal with modern UI/UX framework
Implement mobile-responsive design supporting iOS and Android
Build self-service capabilities for top 10 support call drivers
measurable: Achieve System Usability Scale (SUS) score of 80+ (current: 52)
Reduce support calls related to portal by 30%
Increase client portal login frequency by 50%
Achieve 4.5+ star rating in app stores
achievable: Partner with proven UI/UX design firm with financial services expertise
Leverage existing authentication infrastructure for SSO integration
Pilot with 5 friendly clients before full rollout
Phase implementation over 3 releases to manage risk
relevant: Directly addresses top 3 client pain point from 2024 surveys
Enables future product innovations and service offerings
Aligns with broader platform modernization roadmap

proposedSolution.description: Build a modern, mobile-first client portal using React Native framework for cross-platform support. Implement industry-standard UI patterns from leading fintech companies. Create API-first architecture to enable future integrations and innovations.
keyFeatures: Responsive design optimized for mobile, tablet, and desktop
Real-time account balance and transaction views
Push notifications for important account events
innovations: First FIS portal with native mobile apps
Predictive pre-loading of frequently accessed features
Progressive Web App (PWA) support for offline access

alternativesConsidered.name: White-label Solution
alternativesConsidered.rationale: Rejected due to limited ability to differentiate our brand and long-term costs exceeding custom build

alternativesConsidered.name: Incremental Updates to Existing Portal
cons: Cannot achieve mobile-first design with current architecture
Does not address fundamental UX issues
alternativesConsidered.rationale: Legacy architecture cannot support modern requirements; would be 'throwing good money after bad'

alternativesConsidered.name: Third-party Portal-as-a-Service
alternativesConsidered.rationale: Data residency requirements and integration challenges make this option non-viable
